title: Edges, veneers and finish layers
intro: A finished face is only one part of the specification. Identify the core, facing, edge treatment and visible surfaces, then approve a representative sample.
goals: Identify visible faces and edge treatments

sections.title: Separate core, facing and finish
sections.text: Identify the core and product code, then the facing or paint-ready substrate and final finish. State colour and sheen without using them as a description of the build-up. Check the selected system’s requirements for the back and edges rather than assuming every surface is treated alike.
sections.caption: Core, facing and final finish are separate specification items.

sections.title: Identify visible faces and edge treatments
sections.text: Tag the part faces and edges in drawings and schedules. Specify visible edges, their treatment and stated dimensions. Declare whether scheduled sizes are finished or pre-treatment. Calculate edge effects for the agreed system instead of applying an arbitrary deduction, and record facing direction where it affects the appearance.
sections.caption: Edge treatment links to the part identity and dimension stage.

sections.title: Approve a representative finished sample
sections.text: Request a sample containing core, face and edge in the proposed system. Review it under lighting relevant to the site and record its code, colour, sheen, facing direction and decision. A face-only sample does not demonstrate the edge junction. Revisit approval whenever a material or finish is substituted.
sections.caption: The sample shows the face-to-edge junction as well as colour.

example.title: Worked case and decision
example.text: A light-coloured shelf has a side edge visible from the entrance. The specification names only the colour, and the supplier provides a face-only sample. The complete appearance remains unconfirmed.
example.decision: Decision: define the visible edge treatment and review a face-to-edge sample before approving the system.

quiz.question: Which sample demonstrates the edge junction?
options: A sample with core, face and edge in the proposed system
quiz.explanation: The sample must show the layer junction within the selected system.

assignment.prompt: Specify a shelf visible from two directions, including face tags, edges and approval sample.

faq.question: Can I approve colour from a screen image?
faq.answer: Use the image for initial comparison; approval needs an identified physical sample with the specified finish under suitable lighting.
